name: Camp Farley Overnight Camp
description_short: Overnight camp in Mashpee on Cape Cod for ages 8 to 15, running Sunday to Friday each week. Campers 13 to 15 can stay two weeks, including a Saturday trip. A two-week Counselor-in-Training program is also offered.
refund_policy_summary: $100 deposit per camper is non-refundable and non-transferable. Cancel by March 31, 2027: full refund minus the deposit and a $25 admin fee. April 1 to May 31, 2027: camp keeps the deposit plus 25% of tuition. June 1, 2027 or later: no refund. Prorated refunds for acute medical illness or injury with a doctor's note, at the camp's discretion. No refunds for early departures or late arrivals. Any balance is charged automatically on June 1, 2027.
